bio.text: Dave Wallace is the Republican nominee for Maryland's 2nd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He earned a B.S. in biology from Salisbury University and worked in immunological cancer research for the National Institute of Health.
According to Ballotpedia, he started the business Chesapeake Kitchen Wholesalers in 1981, which he owns, and founded the organization Restore America's Mission in 2008.
